Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://kanpurdehat.dcourts.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Kanpur Dehat PLV recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) posts is 11 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Para Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 50 vacancies announced for the Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) position by the District Legal Services Authority Kanpur Dehat.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DLSA Kanpur Dehat Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the PLV post?
faq.answer: Eligibility includes teachers, retired government employees, senior citizens, law students, Anganwadi workers, doctors, NGO members, and transgender persons, among others.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the PLV posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Para Legal Volunteer posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the official website for DLSA Kanpur Dehat?
faq.answer: The official website for the District Legal Services Authority Kanpur Dehat is https://kanpurdehat.dcourts.gov.in. You can find more details and the application form here.

faq.question: Q7. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for contractual positions. The Para Legal Volunteers will be appointed on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. When did the application process start?
faq.answer: The application process for the DLSA Kanpur Dehat Para Legal Volunteer (PLV) recruitment started on 13 August 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
